facts.version_note: updated_at is the frozen fact version exposed by the API.
facts.value: A null display object causes no state transition. For a non-null DObj, every selected clear bit becomes set, selected bits already set remain set, and all unselected bits remain unchanged. The operation never clears state; HSD_DObjClearFlags and HSD_DObjModifyFlags provide the complementary clearing and masked-replacement transitions.

facts.subject: src/sysdolphin/baselib/dobj.c
facts.version_note: updated_at is the frozen fact version exposed by the API.
facts.value: Descriptor data flows into recursively allocated DObj nodes whose next, MObj, and PObj fields are populated from the corresponding descriptor links; material render-mode bits are converted into DObj display flags. Animation descriptors, start frames, and masks are then forwarded through each DObj to its polygon and material attachments. During post-load fixup, runtime DObj and HSD_DObjDesc lists are paired through their next links and each PObj list is resolved against the corresponding pobjdesc list. During display, the DObj's MObj becomes the current material, establishes render state, and encloses traversal of the attached PObj display methods before that state is cleared.

facts.subject: src/sysdolphin/baselib/dobj.c
facts.version_note: updated_at is the frozen fact version exposed by the API.
facts.value: Most per-object and list-wide operations are null-tolerant. List operations advance through DObj next links, while reference resolution advances runtime and descriptor lists together and stops as soon as either side ends. Loading selects a registered descendant class when available, otherwise the default DObj class, and rejects unexpected material blending modes. Display conditionally brackets all PObj draws with MObj setup and unset according to the render-mode mask, and destruction removes the owned MObj, PObj list, and AObj before invoking the parent release method.
